Two additional files had been downloaded during discarded pre-report attempts. They are not counted as formally audited rows, and their presence does not alter the frozen early-stop decision.

This exact twelve-row search-derived cohort cannot supply the independent native-WCG confirmation required after U1.4C4.
next_leaf: Seek a byte-indexed native-WCG source whose downloadable artifact inventory exposes actual profile identities before selection; do not replace rows or relax the nine-row gate in this cohort.
claim_ceiling: Source-discovery failure evidence only; not a failure of U1.4C4, gamut mapping, arbitrary ICC support, HDR, film/stock evidence, calibration or product ingress.
